$comment: Classification rules for scan-org-links.mjs (fm-a4b). Re-used by the organization rename (fm-rur) as its edit list and post-rename check. First matching rule wins; a hit naming a third-party owner is classed `external` before these rules. `target` is a regex on `<owner>/<name>` (owner empty when templated), `line` a regex on the source line, `paths` globs on the repository path. `to` / `correctName` give the post-rename target for active-link and repo-name-correction hits.

rules.disposition: leave: GitHub REST API hostname has no organisation identity; repository paths come from explicit release inputs
update the checkout's origin to the renamed URL, keeping each repository's identity (never point classic back at the monorepo name)
leave: archived backend content stays as-is; GitHub redirects the old owner while the name is not reclaimed
leave: identity tooling names pre-rename owners on purpose (recorded observations, classification rules and test inputs); the rename re-runs it rather than editing it
leave: byte-identical classic research import checked against docs/research-import/digest-list.json (fm-86u) and the research ledger prefix; GitHub redirects the old owner
leave: PLAN.md link prefixes now name facemorph-me (operator 24 October, fm-fy2.20); remaining bare check-face mentions describe the rename itself and stay as architectural background
leave: frozen plan history and dated findings/receipts; links at pinned commits resolve through the rename redirect and the repository-ID mapping
leave: tracker records describe pre-rename identities; change bead text only with `br update` on the bead concerned
keep: import provenance names classic at pinned commits and runs; it resolves by repository ID 295956585 after the rename
record of the retired native updater feed: retirement disposition, not migration; never point it at the monorepo
leave: live host names registered under the old owner (triton's runner systemd units, the API docs Pages CNAME); the rename does not change them, and the probes must name what is really there
leave: quotes of classic source lines at their recorded revision (copy-inventory.mjs); the edits themselves are fm-ww4's in classic
leave: asserts the immutable import/control-artifact.json release URL, recorded under either owner
generated inventory: re-run its scripts/inventory generator after the rename rather than editing by hand

rules.to: (follows the script's DEFAULT_REPOS / repo arguments, which carry their own hits)
rules.disposition: URL built from the repo argument; it changes with DEFAULT_REPOS, no edit here
URL built from a constant (GITHUB_REPO in apps/web/shell/links.ts, RELEASE_REPO in scripts/import/pin-control.mjs); it changes with that constant, no edit here
compares a link's hostname with github.com and names no owner; no edit on rename
generic GitHub host route/assertions name no owner; repository-specific links still use the normal owner rules
done: already names the renamed organization (fm-fy2.20)
maintained monorepo file: update the owner to facemorph-me (repository name unchanged)

rules.to: (the repository named by its numeric ID at run time)
rules.disposition: no edit: the bare API origin is joined with a path built from a repository ID passed in, which survives the rename

rules.to: (the running repository, resolved at run time)
rules.disposition: no edit: the workflow resolves its own repository when it runs

retire with native packaging: no updater/source migration; keep historical artifacts and provenance; installed-client feed references are inventoried separately so retirement does not point clients at the monorepo

edited by the candidate edit set: ISSUE_REPO and source links name the candidate's actual repository (classic, 295956585) until new-app handover; desktop and API-FAQ links get web-requirements Help and retirement copy
REMOTE names the wrong repository since the earlier rename: retained-candidate promotion uses facemorph-me/facemorph.me-classic; monorepo promotion uses its own repository ID and source
retained-run artifact lookup names the wrong repository: if still runnable, resolve the run in classic by repository ID (`gh api repositories/295956585/actions/runs/<id>/artifacts`)
classic builds link to classic: `githubRepo` becomes facemorph-me/facemorph.me-classic
URL built from `githubRepo`; it changes with the Config.fs correction, no edit here
keep the original repository URL and pinned commit 0abb215f27b16e17e3919cf78b616b6ae4998a5d; add a current-resolution mapping (that commit lives in classic, repository ID 295956585) beside it
update clone/Actions URLs to facemorph-me/facemorph.me-classic; the user-facing README names no branch; check a fresh clone still resolves the pinned frontend commit
update the archived backend's source link to facemorph-me/checkface; API FAQ retirement copy is delivery work, not part of the rename
maintained doc links a classic run under the monorepo's name (broken since the earlier rename): point it at facemorph-me/facemorph.me-classic
legacy production's README (master) links the monorepo's name: point it at facemorph-me/facemorph.me-classic
leave: dated device-lab record ("LIVE 19 September") naming where a runner was registered at the time; runner registration is inventoried as an integration

leave: append-only research history and retired experiments; check-face/facemorph.me run/commit links there belong to classic (repository ID 295956585) and resolve through the lookup mapping, not by rewriting
leave: dated reviews, plans and receipts; check-face/facemorph.me links there name classic before its rename and resolve through the repository-ID mapping
